entries.title: Joshua 18:1
segments:
Shiloh; in the tribe of Ephraim, about twenty-five miles north of Jerusalem, and about fifteen south of Shechem. 
 
The place for public worship should be central, and such as will best accommodate those who are expected there to assemble.

entries.title: Joshua 18:2
segments: Seven tribes; Simeon, Benjamin, Dan, Issachar, Zebulun, Asher, and Naphtali.

entries.title: Joshua 18:3
segments: Men often long remain destitute of many things which it is the will of God that they should enjoy, and which with the right use of means they might enjoy.

entries.title: Joshua 18:5
segments: Their coast; the place already assigned them.

entries.title: Joshua 18:9
segments:
Described it by cities--in a book; they gave a description of the country, as divided by them into seven parts, one for each tribe that had not yet received its inheritance. 
 
In dividing estates, great care should be taken that the boundaries be so fixed as to avoid all future contention about them.

entries.title: Joshua 18:11
segments: Between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph; Judah was on the south, and Ephraim on the north.  Jerusalem was in Benjamin, and thus, as predicted of him, he dwelt in safety by the Lord.

entries.title: Joshua 18:12
segments:
vv 12-28. 
 
The places here mentioned were on the borders of Benjamin's inheritance, which was bounded by the Jordan on the east and Dan on the west.

entries.title: Joshua 18:20
segments: Families are the appointment of Jehovah, and for them he provides with infinite wisdom and goodness.  They are designed and adapted to be sources of great enjoyment on earth adn to be nurseries for heaven.
